explanation: The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created the heavens, the earth, and all life.
The term used to describe God's act of bringing the universe and everything in it into existence.
The Holy Spirit or the inner being of a person that provides divine guidance and power, often contrasted with the flesh.
Human nature characterized by weaknesses, sinful desires, and disobedience to God.
The official instruction or doctrine of the faith that is to be communicated to the church.
False stories or inventions without divine basis that deviate from true teaching.
Restriction of certain things, here specifically marriage and food, commanded by false teachers instead of God's will.
Everything created by God that is good when received with thanksgiving and not rejected.
Dedicated to God or sanctified through faith and the power of the Word, setting it apart from the worldly.
Physical exercise for the body compared to spiritual training which is beneficial in every way.
The act of reinstating or correcting a situation back to its original, true state.
